newsitem.title: USA: Tudor Investment settles SEC civil proceeding.
newsitem.headline: Tudor Investment settles SEC civil proceeding.

text.p: Tudor Investment Corp said Thursday it had agreed to pay an $800,000 penalty in settling a civil proceeding by the Securities and Exchange Commission regarding a series of short sales it had conducted two years ago.
Tudor said the commission found that the sale of certain stocks in the Dow Jones Industrial Average in March 1994 failed to comply with the "uptick rule" governing such sales.
In addition to the penalty, it said it had agreed not to violate the uptick rule again.
"The settlement will not have any impact on investment funds managed by Tudor, nor will it adversely affect Tudor's business or financial condition," it said.
